company: Andrews County Hospital District DBA Permian Regional Medical Center
title: Quality Management Director
text:
**Overview**

The Quality Management Director develops, implements, and maintains the hospital's Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and NIAHO standards. The director oversees the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program and keeps the hospital compliant with CMS Conditions of Participation and state requirements. The role leads survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracers, and plans of correction. The director chairs or coordinates the quality committees, supervises the Quality and Compliance Associate, and monitors regulatory quality requirements. The director also oversees quality and patient safety data reporting, including dashboards and benchmarking, presented to the Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board.

I. Minimum Qualifications:

A. Education:

1. Current licensure to practice as a Registered Professional Nurse in the State of Texas or equivalent degree in healthcare with a minimum of a baccalaureate degree. Master's degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, or a related healthcare field preferred.

2. Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) preferred.

3. Must have at least three (3) years of experience in management or quality improvement in an accredited acute care setting.

II. Knowledge and Skills:

1. Demonstrate knowledge and leadership skills to perform duties outlined in the job description

1. Must have strong knowledge of accrediting and regulatory agency requirements

2. Must have good problem solving, interpersonal communication and project management skills

3. Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication

4. Able to read and interpret medical record documentation and hospital policies and procedures

5. Must have at a minimum proficient computer skills in using Microsoft computer programs (Word, Excel, PPT, etc.)

III. Personal/Physical Requirements:

1. Mental and physical health to meet demands of position

2. Must have respect for human dignity and cultural diversity

3. Demonstrates ability in use of verbal/written communication, and effectively communicate with patients, families, hospital staff, medical staff, and general public.

IV. Data Reporting Requirements:

1. Oversees and supports the data collection, validation, analysis, and submits required quality and patient safety data to regulatory, accrediting, and governmental agencies (e.g., CMS, Texas Health and Human Services, and the hospital's accrediting organization) within required timeframes, including all mandatory quality reporting program measures applicable to a rural hospital.

2. Ensures accuracy, completeness, and integrity of abstracted and reported data through routine audits, validation processes, and corrective action when discrepancies are identified.

3. Prepares and presents routine quality dashboards, scorecards, and trend analyses to the Quality Committee, Medical Staff, Executive Leadership, and Board of Directors, at least quarterly or as required.

4. Benchmarks hospital performance against state, regional, and national comparative data and identifies opportunities for improvement.

5. Maintains confidentiality of patient, and quality data in accordance with HIPAA, and hospital policy, and retains all reports and supporting documentation per record retention requirements.

V. Oversight Responsibilities:

1. Provides oversight of the hospital-wide Quality Management System, including the Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement (QAPI) program, and ensures ongoing compliance with ISO 9001, NIAHO, CMS Conditions of Participation, and applicable state requirements.

2. Oversees survey and accreditation readiness, including mock surveys, tracer activities, and the development, implementation, and monitoring of plans of correction following internal or external surveys.

3. Oversees the work of the Quality and Compliance Associate.

4. Leads and monitors performance improvement projects, applying Lean Six Sigma and other process improvement methodologies, and tracks project outcomes and sustainability.

5. Chairs or coordinates quality committees, ensures committee minutes, action items, and follow-up are documented, and reports quality oversight activities to the Chief Executive Officer and the governing body.

Pay: From $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
